primary.title: The Chemical History of a Candle
primary.author: Michael Faraday
primary.rationale: A series of lectures delivered by Faraday in 1848, later published. It's a foundational text explaining basic chemistry and physics through the example of a candle, making it highly accessible and historically significant.

primary.title: Experimental Researches in Electricity and Magnetism
primary.author: Michael Faraday
primary.rationale: This is a collection of Faraday's own scientific papers detailing his groundbreaking experiments and discoveries in electromagnetism. It is a cornerstone of his scientific legacy.

primary.title: A Course of Six Lectures on the Various Forces of Nature
primary.author: Michael Faraday
primary.rationale: Another set of public lectures by Faraday, demonstrating his ability to explain complex scientific concepts to a general audience. These lectures cover fundamental forces and principles.

secondary.title: Faraday, Maxwell, and the Electromagnetic Field: How Two Men Discovered the Field That Governs Our Lives
secondary.author: Nancy Forbes and Basil Mahon
secondary.rationale: This book provides a modern scholarly analysis of Faraday's contributions to electromagnetism and their connection to James Clerk Maxwell's work, offering insights into his scientific process and impact.

secondary.title: Michael Faraday: A Biography
secondary.author: Frank A. J. L. James
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive scholarly biography of Michael Faraday, written by a leading Faraday scholar, offering in-depth research into his life, work, and times.

secondary.title: The Invention of the Electric Motor
secondary.author: David J. Griffiths
secondary.rationale: While not solely about Faraday, this article likely discusses his foundational experiments in electromagnetism that led to the invention of the electric motor, placing his work in a broader technological context.

suggestions.notes: Faraday's primary works are widely available in digitized formats due to their historical significance. Secondary sources focus on scholarly biographies and analyses of his electromagnetic theories.
